projects.title: XIV QR: Fashion Store UI
projects.alt: XIV QR fashion store e-commerce UI shown on a laptop and phone, designed by Great Emman-Wori
projects.brief: XIV QR is a menswear brand that needed an online store that feels as considered as its clothes. The brief was a clean, editorial shopping experience that works equally well on desktop and phone: a home page that sells the collection, a product listing with real filtering, a focused product page, and a cart and checkout with no friction. I designed the full flow in Figma with a restrained black and grey palette, a bold display typeface and generous photography.

story.title: An editorial home page
story.body: A bold condensed wordmark headline, a quiet grey paper texture and large model photography lead the home page, so the collection reads like a lookbook before it reads like a shop.

story.title: Filters that stay out of the way
story.body: The product listing pairs a collapsible filter column (size, availability, category, colour, price, tags, ratings) with a clean three-column grid. On mobile the same filters fold into an expandable panel above the products.

story.title: A short path to checkout
story.body: Product detail, cart and a three-step checkout (information, shipping, payment) share one layout language on desktop and phone, keeping the order summary visible while the customer fills in details.

results: A complete e-commerce flow designed for desktop and mobile: home, listing, product, cart and checkout
Consistent layout system across screen sizes, ready for developer handoff in Figma
Filtering and a three-step checkout that keep the path from browsing to buying short
